category_title: Advanced students acting as peer mentors
minimal_context: The student is using Khan Academy during an afterschool math club to explore new topic areas and exercises.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please log into Khan Academy for our afterschool math club and begin working on your exercises.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm going to move through the site at my own speed to explore new topic areas.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead and see what you can find.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I need to access information beyond what is in the textbook for my enrichment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should look at next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just moving through the site at my own speed and exploring new topic areas and exercises, but I need you to act as a guide because I've gone through all the standard content.
